heading: Instructional cadence
summary: Each lesson is a phrase: one bar, a beat per page, and a rest for each blank page. A well paced lesson opens lightly, develops, reaches one clear climax, eases off and closes.
blankNote: pages with no children and no content
noLessons: No lessons found in this part of the site.
anacrusisHelp: Opens lightly: the first page with content weighs well under the climax.
developmentHelp: The middle moves up and down on the way to the climax, with no blank pages.
climaxHelp: One clear high point, a quarter heavier than the lesson's typical page, past the first third.
decrescendoHelp: The page after the climax eases off.
cadenceHelp: Closes on a page with content after the climax. Ending on a blank page or on the climax leaves it open (a half cadence).
missing: missing; open the page to look
